title: Trap Escape Dribble Move
description: A ball handler caught in a two-player trap practises a legal spin or retreat dribble to escape before the trap fully closes, without picking up the ball early.

content.objective: Escape a closing trap with a legal dribble move before being forced to pick up the ball.
content.setup: A ball handler is approached by two defenders closing in from both angles to form a trap.
instructions: The ball handler keeps the dribble alive as the trap closes, reading the gap between defenders.
Use a retreat dribble or spin move to escape before the trap fully closes.
Once clear, immediately look to pass to an open teammate rather than dribbling into more pressure.
Reset with the trap closing from different angles each time.
coachingPoints: Keep the dribble alive as long as possible — picking it up early removes all options.
Use a low, controlled move, not a panicked, high dribble.
Look to pass immediately once clear of the trap.
commonMistakes: Picking up the dribble out of panic before the trap is even fully closed.
Dribbling in a tight circle without actually escaping the pressure.
Forcing a long pass when a short outlet was actually available.
content.safety: Trapping defenders keep hands active but do not grab the ball handler.
